## Checklist

- [ ] The change is about one thing
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Documentation updated (README, `docs/`, `.env.example`), if the change touches it
- [ ] Interface texts added to both `es.ts` and `en.ts`, if any
- [ ] A change to the database is a migration, not an edit of the schema
- [ ] No passwords, `.env` files, databases or student data in the diff
